Subsystem_or_Topic: Basecutter Blades (ใบมีดตัดโคน)
Source_A: Case IH / John Deere Global Factory Spec (SRC-02, SRC-05)
Possible_Reason: Global factory configurations target stone-free, leveled clay/loam soils in Brazil and Australia. Thai cane soils in Kanchanaburi, Chaiyaphum, and Nakhon Ratchasima contain heavy laterite gravel and flintstones, where 16° blades chip immediately.
Engineering_Comment: DDC must manufacture 20° bevel angle as the primary product line for Thailand, with 16° offered only as a special order for soft sandy alluvial soils.

Subsystem_or_Topic: Basecutter Discs (จานตัดโคน)
Source_B: Thailand Sugar Mill Contractors (SRC-11, SRC-16, SRC-26)
Possible_Reason: Thai high-tonnage cane (12-18 ton/rai) and lodged cane cause 4-blade discs to push and bulldoze ratoon stools at 6 km/h. 5 blades increase cut frequency by 25% (50 cuts/s) and reduce advance bite to 3.33 cm.
Engineering_Comment: Standardize DDC basecutter disc manufacturing exclusively on the 5-hole scalloped pattern. 4-blade discs have zero aftermarket commercial viability in Thailand.

Subsystem_or_Topic: Basecutter Discs (จานตัดโคน)
Source_B: Thai Field Workshops & CSC Machinery (SRC-16, SRC-26)
Value_B: Open Scalloped Disc 610mm with Stone Ejector Pockets
Possible_Reason: Closed solid discs trap wet clay and wedge stones against the gearbox pan, causing severe friction, horsepower drag, and disc warping. Scalloped cutouts eject debris centrifugally.
Recommended_Value: Open Scalloped Disc (จานเปิดสลัดหิน)
Engineering_Comment: Mandate scalloped profiles with CNC plasma/laser cutting from 12mm-16mm high-strength SAPH440 / Strenx plate.

Subsystem_or_Topic: Extractor Fan Blades (พัดลมดูดใบ)
Possible_Reason: Stones thrown upward into the extractor hood impact aluminum blades at 1,200 RPM, shattering aluminum blade tips and destroying the impeller hub. Polymer absorbs stone impacts without fracturing.
Engineering_Comment: DDC should develop injection-molded reinforced polymer blades for superior fatigue life and weight reduction.

Subsystem_or_Topic: Elevator Slat Conveyor (รางเทลิฟท์)
Source_B: Local Thai Fabricators & Sugar Mills (SRC-16, SRC-24, SRC-26)
Possible_Reason: Sugarcane juice is acidic (pH 5.0-5.5) and contains wet abrasive sand. Mild steel corrodes and wears through within one season. Stainless SUS304 resists juice corrosion while Hardox resists severe gouging.
Engineering_Comment: DDC should offer laser-cut drop-in SUS304 floor liner retrofit kits as a premium long-life product.

Subsystem_or_Topic: Chopper Knives (ใบมีดสับท่อน)
Source_B: Contractors in Bo Phloi & Isan Stony Fields (SRC-16, SRC-17)
Value_B: 10.0 mm Heavy Duty Knife with Hardfaced Bevel
Possible_Reason: In fields with heavy trash and stone intake, 8.0mm knives flex and chip on rock impacts. 10.0mm knives provide 25% higher bending stiffness and survive full-season high-impact operations.
Engineering_Comment: DDC product catalog should carry both 8.0mm (standard volume) and 10.0mm (extreme rock protection) SKUs.
